topic.title: Fixed Layout EPUB
topic.shortdesc: Creating pre-paginated EPUBs with fixed dimensions for comics, children's books, and highly designed content.

body.p: While most EPUBs use the reflowable layoutreflowable layout model — where content adapts to the reader's screen size and font preferences — some publications require precise visual control. fixed layoutFXLFixed layout (FXL) EPUB provides a pre-paginated format where each page has exact pixel dimensions, similar to a PDF.

section.title: When to Use Fixed Layout

ul.li: Comics and graphic novels — where panel layout is integral to the reading experience
Children's picture books — where text and illustrations have precise spatial relationships
Highly designed content — cookbooks, art books, magazines where layout is the content
Technical diagrams — where spatial accuracy matters more than reflowability

section.note: Fixed layout EPUBs do not reflow, so they cannot adapt to different screen sizes, user font preferences, or accessibility zoom settings. This significantly limits their accessibility. Use reflowable layout unless you have a compelling reason not to.

section.title: FXL Parameters
section.p: Enable fixed layout by setting epub.layout=fixed:

row.entry: Spread mode: auto, both, landscape, none

section.title: FXL Output Differences
section.p: When fixed layout is enabled, the plugin:

ul.li: Sets rendition:layout to pre-paginated in the OPF metadata
Injects a viewport <meta> tag in every XHTML file: <meta name="viewport" content="width=1024, height=768"/>
